desc: The LAZARUS 6 is a compact, hard-use suppressor that offers users the versatility to quickly and easily configure their suppressor with a variety of mounting and front-end cap options to tailor the assembly to their specific needs. The LAZARUS 6 features a body made from Haynes 282, produced using additive manufacturing techniques. Inside the LAZARUS 6 are three patent-pending Triskelion baffles and the Triskelion Gas Management System. This design provides excellent acoustic performance, muzzle-flash mitigation, and thermal management while minimizing the increase in operating velocity of the host firearm's reciprocating components. Although optimized for use on 5.56 x 45 hosts, the LAZARUS 6 can also be used effectively on hosts chambered for 6mm Creedmoor and 6mm ARC.
